build_mrp_process_conda: build an mrp process that compiles and runs a C++ OMPL program inside a conda environment
create_mrp_conda_runtime: create an mrp.Conda runtime with conda-forge and robostack channels and ros-foxy-ompl dependency
run_mrp_setup_commands: run g++ setup commands to compile a C++ source file against OMPL and Eigen3 headers
review_mrp_noescape: review the mrp.NoEscape usage to prevent shell variable escaping in compile and run commands
test_mrp_main: test the mrp.main entry point to start and manage the defined process via the mrp CLI
